# QS-CFW-1392-34 Quality specification - crankshaft blank CFW-1392-34 (4340)
Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-1392-34  
This revision supersedes Rev D.

Scope
This quality specification applies to the manufacture, inspection, and acceptance of crankshaft blank CFW-1392-34 produced from 4340 material at Plant P1. It establishes dimensional, hardness, and weight requirements for incoming and in-process inspection and final release.

Requirements table
| Requirement | Specification |
|---|---|
| Material | 4340 (as specified on part drawing) |
| Hardness (as received) | 34-37 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.04 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | 6.7 kg. |
| Visual | Free of cracks, laps, and forging-scale entrapment that affect machinability |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Verify hardness on representative locations using a calibrated Rockwell tester following manufacturer procedure. Record results on inspection record and compare to 34-37 HRC. Hardness readings outside this range constitute a nonconformance.
- Bore diameter: Measure bore diameter with calibrated bore gauge or internal micrometer; results must meet ±0.04 mm. Document measurements on dimensional inspection form.
- Weight: Use calibrated scale to determine forging weight; confirm it does not exceed 6.7 kg. Record actual weight on the work order.
- Visual: Inspect under consistent lighting for forging defects that impact function or machining. Reject parts with disqualifying defects.

Nonconformance handling
Parts failing any requirement are segregated, tagged, and routed to quality for disposition. For hardness, bore, or weight nonconformances, complete a nonconformance report and document rejection reason and disposition. Rework is permitted only if a documented rework plan is approved by Quality and returns the part to full compliance with this specification. Scrap is dispositioned per Plant P1 scrap procedure. Final release requires Quality sign-off on the inspection record.
